title: Jamaican Pork Tenderloin Hash
description: A malty and flaky Jamaican dish featuring pork tenderloin, perfect for a sick day, made egg-free friendly and air-fried to perfection. This dish combines the flavors of Jamaica with a twist on traditional hash.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, malt vinegar, jerk seasoning, brown sugar, salt, and pepper.
Add the pork tenderloin to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the flour mixture.
Place the coated pork tenderloin in the air fryer basket and cook for 12 minutes.
Shake the basket halfway through cooking to ensure even cooking.
Once the pork is cooked, remove it from the air fryer and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the pork into thin strips and set aside.
In the same air fryer basket, add the vegetable oil and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the sliced pork back to the air fryer basket and cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Serve the Jamaican pork tenderloin hash hot and enjoy.
